```{r}
# 1. Load Bootstrapped Cluster Tree & Photophysiology Matrix
load(here("Data", "Alls.cor_clean.RData"))      # Scaled clean matrix (samples x metrics)
load(here("Data", "cbb_AS26_expt_1000bs_updated.RData")) # Bootstrapped dendrogram (cbb)
raw<-read.csv(here("Data", "TUT_experimental_data.csv"))
ed_data <- read.csv(here("Data", "AS26_ED50_CI_BIC_TAO.csv"))

# 2. Extract Hierarchical Clusters across K = 2 to 15
sample_ids <- cbb$hclust$labels
cluster_matrix <- map_dfc(2:15, function(k) {
  cutree(cbb$hclust, k = k)
})
colnames(cluster_matrix) <- paste0("K_", 2:15)

df_clusters <- data.frame(SampleID = sample_ids, cluster_matrix) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleID_clean = SampleID %>%
      tolower() %>%
      str_replace("\\.processed\\.csv$", "") %>%
      str_replace("\\._?\\d{2,3}r$", "") %>%
      trimws()
  )

# 3. Construct Master Analysis Dataframe
allphoto_df <- as.data.frame(Alls.cor_clean)
allphoto_df$SampleID_clean <- rownames(Alls.cor_clean)

df_master <- allphoto_df %>%
  inner_join(df_clusters, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    site     = as.numeric(str_extract(SampleID_clean, "(?<=^t)\\d+")),
    colony   = str_extract(SampleID_clean, "(?<=_)[a-z0-9]+$"),
    species  = str_to_upper(str_extract(colony, "^[a-z]+")),
    col_num  = as.numeric(str_extract(colony, "\\d+$")),
    Genotype = paste0(species, "_s", formatC(site, flag = "0", width = 2), 
                      "_c", formatC(col_num, flag = "0", width = 2))
  ) %>%
  left_join(ed_data, by = "Genotype") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50), ED50 < 40, ED50ci95 <= 2) %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("K_"), site, species), as.factor))

cat("Master dataset assembled:", nrow(df_master), "samples aligned with ED50 metrics.\n")
```
```{r}
# 1. Base Model: Species alone
m_species <- lmer(ED50 ~ species + (1 | site), data = df_master, REML = FALSE)

# 2. Screen Cluster Levels K_2 through K_15 + Species
k_cols <- paste0("K_", 2:15)

model_comp_table <- map_dfr(k_cols, function(k_name) {
  form <- as.formula(paste("ED50 ~ species +", k_name, "+ (1 | site)"))
  mod  <- lmer(form, data = df_master, REML = FALSE)
  perf <- model_performance(mod)
  
  data.frame(
    Cluster_K      = k_name,
    AIC            = perf$AIC,
    BIC            = perf$BIC,
    R2_Marginal    = perf$R2_marginal,
    R2_Conditional = perf$R2_conditional
  )
}) %>% arrange(AIC)

print(head(model_comp_table, 5))

# 3. Fit Optimal Target Model (K_3)
mod_k3 <- lmer(ED50 ~ species + K_3 + (1 | site), data = df_master, REML = TRUE)
summary(mod_k3)

# 4. Extract Marginal Means for K_3
k3_emm <- emmeans(mod_k3, ~ K_3)
cld_k3 <- cld(k3_emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters) %>% mutate(.group = trimws(.group))

# Plot K_3 performance controlled for species
custom_shapes <- c(15, 16, 17, 18, 21, 22, 23, 24)

ggplot(cld_k3, aes(x = K_3, y = emmean)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), width = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
   scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  geom_text(aes(label = .group, y = upper.CL + 0.1), fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline Phenotype ED50 Performance (K=3)",
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster (K=3)",
    y = expression(Estimated~Marginal~Mean~ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")")
  )

ggplot() +
  # LAYER 1: Raw data points in the background (faded and jittered)
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_master,
    aes(x = as.factor(K_3), y = ED50, color = species, shape = as.factor(site)),
    width = 0.15, alpha = 0.35, size = 2.5
  ) +
  
  # LAYER 2: Model-estimated marginal means (Large black diamond)
  geom_point(
    data = cld_k3,
    aes(x = as.factor(K_3), y = emmean),
    size = 4.5, shape = 18, color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # LAYER 3: Model 95% Confidence Intervals (controlling for site variance)
  geom_errorbar(
    data = cld_k3,
    aes(x = as.factor(K_3), ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.12, linewidth = 1.1, color = "black"
  ) +
  
  # LAYER 4: Post-hoc Tukey significance letters mapped above CIs
  geom_text(
    data = cld_k3,
    aes(x = as.factor(K_3), y = upper.CL + 0.12, label = .group),
    fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "black"
  ) +
   scale_shape_manual(values = custom_shapes) +
  # Formatting
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Thermal Tolerance Shifts Across Baseline Phenotypes",
    subtitle = "Diamonds show model EMMs (95% CI) controlling for Site and Species",
    x = "Photophysiological Cluster (K=3)",
    y = expression(Estimated~Marginal~Mean~ED[50]~"("*degree*C*")"),
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Site"
  )
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rstatix)
library(tidyr)

# 0. Build a safe mapping frame to align row counts by Sample ID
cluster_map <- df_master %>% 
  dplyr::select(SampleID_clean, K_3)

# 1. Add Cluster_3 binary indicator (Cluster 3 vs Others) safely using join
df_mech <- as.data.frame(Alls.cor_clean) %>%
  mutate(SampleID_clean = rownames(Alls.cor_clean)) %>%
  inner_join(cluster_map, by = "SampleID_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(-SampleID_clean) %>%
  rename(Cluster = K_3) %>%
  mutate(Is_Cluster_3 = as.factor(ifelse(Cluster == 3, "Tolerant_C3", "Baseline"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cluster))

# 1b. CLEAN NAs FOR RANDOM FOREST (Strips columns or rows containing NAs)
df_mech_rf <- df_mech %>%
  # Drop any columns that are entirely or mostly NA
  dplyr::select(where(~ sum(is.na(.)) == 0)) %>%
  # Omit any remaining rows with NAs
  na.omit()

# 2. Run Random Forest to classify Cluster 3
# Exclude raw Cluster column so RF only trains on photophysiology features
rf_fit_c3 <- randomForest(Is_Cluster_3 ~ . - Cluster, data = df_mech_rf, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

# 3. Extract top 20 driving metrics
# 3. Extract top 20 driving metrics
imp_c3 <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_fit_c3)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Metric") %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini)) %>%
  head(20)

print(imp_c3)

# 4. Run post-hoc test to see directionality (Is trait HIGHER or LOWER in Cluster 3?)
top_metrics <- imp_c3$Metric

cluster3_mechanisms <- df_mech_rf %>%
  dplyr::select(Cluster, all_of(top_metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Cluster, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Metric, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cluster, names_prefix = "Cluster_", values_from = Mean_Value) %>%
  mutate(Diff_3_vs_Rest = Cluster_3 - ((Cluster_1 + Cluster_2) / 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Diff_3_vs_Rest)))

print(cluster3_mechanisms) #top 20 drivers

```

```{r}


# 1. Format the mechanisms table for clear biological interpretation
cluster3_plot_df <- cluster3_mechanisms %>%
  mutate(
    # Label whether the trait is higher or lower in the heat-tolerant cluster
    Direction = ifelse(Diff_3_vs_Rest > 0, "ELEVATED in Cluster 3", "SUPPRESSED in Cluster 3"),
    
    # Create absolute difference for ranking bar length
    Abs_Diff = abs(Diff_3_vs_Rest)
  ) %>%
  # Keep top 15 clearest drivers for cleaner plotting
  head(15)

# 2. Print summary table to console
cat("--- TOP PHYSIOLOGICAL DRIVERS OF CLUSTER 3 THERMAL TOLERANCE ---\n")
print(cluster3_plot_df %>% dplyr::select(Metric, Cluster_3, Cluster_1, Cluster_2, Diff_3_vs_Rest, Direction))

# 3. Build the Mechanism Divergence Plot
ggplot(cluster3_plot_df, aes(x = reorder(Metric, Diff_3_vs_Rest), y = Diff_3_vs_Rest, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ELEVATED in Cluster 3" = "firebrick3", "SUPPRESSED in Cluster 3" = "navyblue")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline Physiological Divergence of Cluster 3",
    subtitle = "Standardized Trait Shift relative to Baseline Clusters (1 & 2)",
    x = "Photophysiological Metric",
    y = "Trait Shift (Z-Score Difference: Cluster 3 - Baseline Avg)",
    fill = "Phenotype Shift"
  )
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate t-test / LMM for every trait: Cluster 3 vs. Rest
trait_diffs <- map_dfr(ppParam_thinned, function(trait) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~ (K_3 == 3)"))
  fit <- lm(form, data = df_master)
  res <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, ]
  
  data.frame(
    Metric = trait,
    Estimate = res["Estimate"], # Direction of shift in Cluster 3
    P_Value = res["Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(P_Value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = FDR < 0.05
  )

# Plot Volcano Plot of Drivers
ggplot(trait_diffs, aes(x = Estimate, y = -log10(P_Value), color = Significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey60", "firebrick")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Photophysiological Drivers of Cluster 3 Heat Tolerance",
    x = "Trait Value Shift in Cluster 3 (Z-Score Difference)",
    y = expression(-log[10](p-value))
  )
```

```{r}
#this is when things go south...
# Extract clean numeric photophysiology metrics
pp_metrics <- colnames(Alls.cor_clean)

# 1. Graph Network Collinearity Thinning
cor_mat <- cor(df_master[, pp_metrics], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
diag(cor_mat) <- 0
adj_mat <- abs(cor_mat) > 0.6
adj_mat[is.na(adj_mat)] <- FALSE

g_net <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "upper", diag = FALSE)
net_clusters <- components(g_net)$membership
pp_thinned <- pp_metrics[!duplicated(net_clusters)]

cat("Reduced features from", length(pp_metrics), "to", length(pp_thinned), "via network partitioning.\n")

# 2. LASSO Stability Selection
X_mat <- as.matrix(df_master[, pp_thinned])
y_vec <- df_master$ED50

stab_fit <- stabsel(
  x = X_mat, y = y_vec,
  fitfun = glmnet.lasso,
  cutoff = 0.6,
  PFER = 5,
  B = 500
)

selected_drivers <- names(stab_fit$selected)
cat("LASSO Selected Drivers of ED50:\n")
print(selected_drivers) #0!

# Fallback safety if LASSO is ultra-conservative
if(length(selected_drivers) < 2) {
  selected_drivers <- pp_thinned[1:4]
}
```

```{r}
# 1. Extract selected driver columns
umap_input <- df_master[, selected_drivers]

# 2. Scale z-scores safely
umap_input <- scale(umap_input)

# 3. Clean out any non-finite (NA/NaN/Inf) cells or zero-variance columns created by scale()
umap_input <- as.data.frame(umap_input) %>%
  dplyr::select(where(~ all(is.finite(.)) & sd(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 4. Check that we still have finite numeric drivers ready for UMAP
cat("Dimensions going into UMAP:", dim(umap_input)[1], "rows x", dim(umap_input)[2], "cols\n")

# 5. Run UMAP smoothly
umap_fit <- umap(
  umap_input,
  n_neighbors = 15,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "euclidean",
  random_state = 42
)

df_umap <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap_fit$layout[, 1],
  UMAP2 = umap_fit$layout[, 2],
  Species = df_master$species,
  Site = df_master$site,   K_3 = df_master$K_3,
  ED50 = df_master$ED50
)

# 2. Plot UMAP Space: Colored by ED50-Validated Hierarchical Clusters
ggplot(df_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = K_3, shape = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "LASSO-Targeted Photophysiology UMAP",
    subtitle = "Manifold built on ED50 drivers; colored by K=3 hclust groups",
    x = "UMAP Dimension 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimension 2",
    color = "Hierarchical Cluster (K=3)",
    shape = "Species Identity"
  )
# Plot the 4 LASSO drivers, but color by actual Heat Tolerance (ED50)
ggplot(df_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = ED50, shape = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Thermal Tolerance Manifold (LASSO Drivers)",
    subtitle = "Points arranged by ED50 functional drivers, colored by thermal threshold",
    x = "UMAP Dimension 1",
    y = "UMAP Dimension 2",
    color = "ED50 (°C)",
    shape = "Species"
  )

# Pick your top LASSO driver (e.g. Connect.18.0)
top_driver <- selected_drivers[1]

ggplot(df_master, aes(x = .data[[top_driver]], y = ED50, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +

    title = paste("Baseline Driver vs Heat Tolerance"),

  )

# Pivot the 4 drivers into long format for a quick 4-panel ggplot
df_master %>%
  dplyr::select(species, ED50, all_of(selected_drivers)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(selected_drivers), names_to = "Driver", values_to = "TraitValue") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TraitValue, y = ED50, color = K_3)) +

  )

ggplot(df_master, aes(x = .data[[selected_drivers[1]]], y = ED50, color = as.factor(K_3))) +

ggplot(df_master, aes(x = .data[[selected_drivers[1]]], y = ED50, color = as.factor(K_3))) +
```

```{r}
# 1. Linear Discriminant Analysis on Species using Selected Drivers
lda_df <- df_master[, c("species", selected_drivers)]
lda_fit <- lda(species ~ ., data = lda_df)
lda_pred <- predict(lda_fit)

df_lda_plot <- data.frame(
  Species = lda_df$species,
  LD1 = lda_pred$x[, 1]
)

ggplot(df_lda_plot, aes(x = LD1, fill = Species)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "LDA Species Discrimination",
    subtitle = "Separation along First Discriminant Axis driven by LASSO features",
    x = "Linear Discriminant 1",
    y = "Density"
  )

# 2. Random Forest: Metrics distinguishing K_3 Clusters
rf_df <- df_master[, c("K_3", pp_thinned)]
rf_fit <- randomForest(K_3 ~ ., data = rf_df, ntree = 500, importance = TRUE)

rf_importance <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_fit)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Metric") %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanDecreaseGini))

ggplot(head(rf_importance, 15), aes(x = reorder(Metric, MeanDecreaseGini), y = MeanDecreaseGini)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Photophysiological Features Driving K=3 Clusters",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Mean Decrease in Gini Impurity"
  )
```
